paragraphs.text: South Pontotoc fans can catch both varsity teams against Mooreville in New Albany on Tuesday, Nov. 24. The girls tip off at 4:30 p.m. and the boys follow at 5:45 p.m. Both matchups are on the New Albany Thanksgiving Tournament schedule. All times are Central.

The Cougars have different opponents Monday. The girls play Shannon at 11:30 a.m., while the boys face Alcorn Central at 12:45 p.m. in the New Albany tournament. South’s boys carry a four-game winning streak into that matchup after starting the season with two losses. They scored at least 63 points in each of their last three wins.

South’s girls are 6–0. Lafayette, which scored 42 against them Thursday, is the only opponent to reach 40. Mooreville comes into the holiday week off a 71–56 win over Hatley and has a Monday game with Ripley before facing the Cougars. Mooreville and Ripley went to overtime in their first meeting Nov. 17, a 67–62 Ripley win.

Pontotoc’s boys head to Booneville for a 4:30 p.m. game Monday against Florence of Alabama. Both teams reached the weekend at 3–1. The Warriors won 59–54 at Tupelo on Thursday, the same night Florence took its first loss, 84–70 to Bob Jones. The Falcons scored at least 70 in all four games.

Pontotoc’s girls are listed in Booneville against Center Hill at 1:30 p.m. Tuesday. The boys’ schedule also carries a Tuesday Booneville tournament slot, but it had neither an opponent nor a tipoff time as of Saturday afternoon.
